title: Intermittent: free nodes unplaced on scope load, edges stretch then slowly settle (load-order race)

sections.what: Reproduced intermittently: reloading/deep-woods sometimes yields total edge length ~6.38M px (nodes flung, edges stretched, settling slowly over >1.5s), other times ~328K px (placed, instant). Same scope, same code, non-deterministic. Root cause: on load the free content nodes (items etc.) are unplaced at the instant the solver starts, so physics flings them outward and edges stretch until it converges; painted areas/ways are seeded from cell so they snap in <1s. Fix: apply all positions (seed painted from cell, place content relative to its area) synchronously before the solver runs, so the load is deterministic and does not depend on winning a race.
